mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of overall economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with positive HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances with negative INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a 3-month period, it signals a shift towards consumer-driven growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month, coupled with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1%, signals inflationary pressure without sufficient monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS < 1%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.3%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances with negative GDPC1 growth.
